traits.name: Doctor's Hand
traits.text: When the surgeon rolls a critical failure on a check to Treat Disease, Treat Poison, or [Treat Wounds](../../rules/actions/treat-wounds.md), they get a failure instead.

traits.name: Medical Malpractice
traits.text: ⬻ The surgeon attempts a Medicine check against the Fortitude DC of one living creature they can see within 60 feet. On a success, the surgeon's melee Strikes deal an extra 1d6 (1d6) precision damage against that creature (2d6 (2d6) on a critical success) until 1 minute passes or the surgeon critically hits that creature, whichever comes first. Using this action again designates a new target and ends the effect for any previous target. A surgeon can target an individual creature no more than once per day with this ability.

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ scalpel +11 (agile, thrown 10 feet, versatile p); Damage 1d4+1 (1d4+1) slashing
